inspiration.observed_pattern: A view joins parent JSON documents to JSON_TABLE and exposes typed parent fields together with one row per nested line item.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an order-line view over independently authored order payloads. MariaDB JSON_TABLE uses CROSS JOIN, typed VARCHAR/INT/DECIMAL columns, and a NESTED PATH with FOR ORDINALITY to expose each order item through a reusable view. Oracle NUMBER/VARCHAR2 types, purchase-order names, JSON values, and source schema are not copied.

fixture_notes: Two order payloads contain two and one line items respectively. The view must repeat each order's customer code for every nested line, assign per-order ordinality, and preserve typed quantity and unit price values.
determinism_notes: Order IDs, customer codes, JSON documents, nested item order, declared types, and final order-by keys are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE order_payloads (order_id INT PRIMARY KEY, customer_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, payload JSON NOT NULL)

steps.sql: CREATE VIEW order_item_lines AS SELECT p.order_id, p.customer_code, jt.line_no, jt.sku, jt.description, jt.quantity, jt.unit_price FROM order_payloads AS p CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(p.payload, '$' COLUMNS (NESTED PATH '$.items[*]' COLUMNS (line_no FOR ORDINALITY, sku VARCHAR(16) PATH '$.sku', description VARCHAR(64) PATH '$.description', quantity INT PATH '$.quantity', unit_price DECIMAL(8,2) PATH '$.unit_price'))) AS jt
SELECT order_id, customer_code, line_no, sku, description, quantity, unit_price FROM order_item_lines ORDER BY order_id, line_no

checks.sql: SELECT order_id, customer_code, line_no, sku, quantity FROM order_item_lines ORDER BY order_id, line_no
